feature_preprocessing.none_to_zero: every numeric input (gap_beats, prev_dur_beats, leap_abs, prev_black, ...)
feature_preprocessing.collinearity: exact linear dependencies exist by construction (is_chord = 1 - chord_pos=single, chord_outer = chord_pos=bottom + chord_pos=top, in_run = 1 - run_pos=none, leap_bin=none = first_of_hand, repeated = leap_bin=repeat); the L2 penalty splits such effects among the columns, so read a group's coefficients together

validation.scheme: 5-fold GroupKFold by part_id; part ids permuted with numpy.random.default_rng(0) and encoded as their permuted rank before sklearn's size-balanced assignment
validation.density_matched_threshold: per fold, the threshold on the training-fold in-sample scores of the group (overall for 'overall') that makes the predicted density equal the group's editorial density on the training folds; applied to the test fold

model_params.logistic: make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=1000, class_weight=None)); n_jobs not passed because scikit-learn 1.8 ignores it for LogisticRegression (FutureWarning); threads capped with OMP_NUM_THREADS=2

rule_spec.note: binary predictor, no fitting; AUC of a 0/1 score = (TPR + TNR) / 2

rule_spec_plus_after_long_note.note: binary predictor, no fitting; AUC of a 0/1 score = (TPR + TNR) / 2

rule_spec_minus_chord_outer.note: binary predictor, no fitting; AUC of a 0/1 score = (TPR + TNR) / 2

teaching_only.note: teaching-only models are trained and tested on teaching rows with the same part folds; density-matched thresholds use the teaching density of the training folds for both

tree.fit: all Mutopia rows; class weights shown by export_text are [unprinted, printed]

library_check.overlap_note: The eight library pieces (Burgmuller Op. 100 Nos. 1/2/3/5, Schumann Op. 68/1, Mozart K545 i, Moonlight i, Chopin Op. 69/2) are also in the Mutopia corpus, so models fitted on all Mutopia rows have seen the same music (with Mutopia's fingerings, which may come from the same or a different edition). This is not a clean hold-out; the *_excl_overlap models are refitted without the matching Mutopia parts.
library_check.teaching_density_matched_threshold: threshold on the model's own training rows of the teaching group that makes the predicted density equal the teaching density
